obligations.description: Result should remain non-negative under validated inputs

assumptions.description: Balance must be non-negative at the time of withdrawal
assumptions.justification: A negative balance is economically invalid and would undermine all safety proofs; account invariants enforce non-negative balance at creation and after every operation

assumptions.description: Withdrawal amount must be non-negative; a negative amount would represent a deposit disguised as a withdrawal
assumptions.justification: API schema for withdrawal endpoint rejects negative amount values at the boundary before reaching business logic
